name: Generic UDS templates
author: bod3
description: Starting points for your own tests. Identifiers are placeholders: copy a template, replace the DID/routine with the one from your module's documentation and import it as your own recipe.

recipes.name: Output control (template)
recipes.description: Short-term adjustment of one output through InputOutputControlByIdentifier, returned to the ECU afterwards.
safety: Template: DID 0100 is a placeholder and does nothing useful on most modules.
Only run tests whose effect you know; keep hands and tools away from moving parts.
recipes.notes: Most modules answer NRC 31 (request out of range) to unknown identifiers, which ends the test safely.

recipes.name: Routine (template)
recipes.description: Starts a routine, polls its results and stops it.
safety: Some routines move actuators or run pumps; read the module documentation first.
